source.description: P0 data-loss incident observed 2026-07-14 12:44 local: ~/.xtrm/skills/state.json was rewritten to installedVersion 0.0.0-test with empty enabledPacks and ~/.xtrm/skills/default was emptied, breaking all Pi/Claude global skill symlinks and hard-failing every skill-declaring specialist. Timing and 0.0.0-test fingerprint point to an xtmux installer test using the real HOME. Fix every installer/bootstrap test to require a disposable HOME/XDG root and add an invariant that refuses test-version writes under the real home. Recovery performed with `xt bootstrap --force`; verified state version 0.10.6 and 52 global skills. Cross-reference core incident xtrm-y86om.
source.title: Installer tests must never mutate real ~/.xtrm global state
